article_title: First wave of 'pounds for pylons' energy discount sites revealed

tasks.prompt: What is the main announcement in the article?
options: All electricity customers will receive free power for ten years
The first 43 grid projects whose nearby households may receive annual bill discounts have been named
Britain will remove every existing electricity pylon
Renewable-energy companies will stop building substations
tasks.correct_answer: The first 43 grid projects whose nearby households may receive annual bill discounts have been named
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החדשות המרכזיות הן פרסום הגל הראשון של 43 מיזמי הולכה שבקרבתם משקי בית עשויים לקבל הנחה שנתית.

tasks.prompt: Who is expected to be eligible for the scheme?
options: Households anywhere in Europe that use renewable energy
Businesses that build wind turbines offshore
Households within about 500 metres of qualifying new or upgraded transmission infrastructure
Only residents who already own an electricity pylon
tasks.correct_answer: Households within about 500 metres of qualifying new or upgraded transmission infrastructure
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הזכאות מיועדת למשקי בית בטווח של כ־500 מטר מתשתית הולכה חדשה או משודרגת שנכללת בתוכנית.

tasks.prompt: What does “eligible” mean in the article?
options: Legally forbidden from applying
Able to qualify under the scheme's rules
Responsible for building the pylons
Uncertain about the cost
tasks.correct_answer: Able to qualify under the scheme's rules
tasks.explanation_hebrew: eligible פירושו עומד בתנאי הזכאות ויכול לקבל את ההטבה לפי כללי התוכנית.

tasks.prompt: What benefit can a qualifying household receive?
options: A £250 yearly electricity-bill discount for up to ten years
A one-time free solar panel worth £80
A new home built beside the substation
Free electricity only during the winter
tasks.correct_answer: A £250 yearly electricity-bill discount for up to ten years
tasks.explanation_hebrew: משק בית זכאי עשוי לקבל הנחה של 250 ליש״ט בשנה בחשבון החשמל, למשך עד עשר שנים.

tasks.prompt: Why does the government link local discounts to new grid infrastructure?
options: To discourage homes from using electricity
To give affected communities a direct benefit and help secure support for grid expansion
To make renewable electricity illegal in rural areas
To replace the energy regulator with local councils
tasks.correct_answer: To give affected communities a direct benefit and help secure support for grid expansion
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הרעיון הוא לתת תמורה מוחשית לתושבים המארחים תשתית, ובכך לצמצם התנגדות ולעזור להרחיב את הרשת.

tasks.prompt: When critics call the compensation “meagre”, what do they mean?
options: It is unusually generous
It is paid too quickly
It is too small or inadequate
It is available only in cash
tasks.correct_answer: It is too small or inadequate
tasks.explanation_hebrew: meagre מתאר סכום קטן ולא מספק; המבקרים טוענים שההנחה אינה מפצה כראוי את התושבים.

tasks.prompt: State three key rules or figures of the discount scheme.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה פרטים מדויקים, כגון המרחק, הסכום, משך ההטבה או מספר המיזמים בגל הראשון.
expected_points: The first wave covers 43 transmission projects across Britain
Eligible households are within about 500 metres (1,600 feet)
Payments can continue for up to 10 years

tasks.prompt: Summarise the purpose of the scheme and the disagreement about it in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לתאר את ההטבה, את הצורך בהרחבת רשת החשמל ואת הביקורת על גובה הפיצוי או השפעת התשתית.
expected_points: Nearby households receive a direct bill discount
Britain needs more transmission capacity to connect renewable generation
Ministers say community benefits can support construction and growth
Critics and some residents consider the compensation too small for the local impact

tasks.prompt: How could a lack of transmission capacity slow the move to renewable energy?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשור בין ייצור חשמל מתחדש, היכולת להעביר אותו ברשת והצורך בקווים ובתחנות משנה חדשים או משודרגים.
expected_points: Wind and solar power may be generated far from consumers
The grid needs enough capacity to carry that electricity
Insufficient capacity can delay connections or waste available generation
New transmission projects can unlock renewable power and economic activity

tasks.prompt: Do bill discounts provide fair compensation for communities near pylons? Give a balanced answer using evidence from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג יתרון וטיעון נגדי, להשתמש בפרטי התוכנית ולסיים במסקנה מנומקת.
expected_points: The £250 annual discount is a tangible benefit for eligible households
The benefit may last up to ten years
Residents experience visual or neighbourhood impacts from major infrastructure
Critics describe the compensation as meagre or showing insufficient regard
